_what: STARTER DATA for a tester's first site film: the data files one film needs, so the engine (which builds offline) finds them. NEXT-RENDERER 44. Names are the data folder's own file names (read from the dataset clients, not traced by a render); sizes are measured from Ryan's PC cache on 2026-10-30. A film outside the window or the dataset waits for a download plan (maker_fetch) the person approves.
film: Housing: new homes permitted per 1,000 residents, by county
files: ne{YYYY}a.txt, mw{YYYY}a.txt, so{YYYY}a.txt, we{YYYY}a.txt for each year 2010..2024 (place summaries, who reported)
cc-est2020int-agesex-{SS}.csv for each of the 51 state codes (county population 2010-2019)
sub-est2024_9.csv, SUB-EST2020_9.csv (town population, for Connecticut's planning regions)
geo/cb_2024_us_county_500k, geo/cb_2021_us_county_20m, geo/cb_2013_us_county_20m, geo/cb_2024_us_county_20m, geo/cb_2024_us_state_20m (county and state shapes)
note: The full 1990-2024 Housing start needs about 397 MB, of which 239 MB is the ten 1990s population files; a 2010-2024 window needs about 98 MB. Which window a tester's first film uses is WEB's and Ryan's call (the builder's Housing start says 1990 to 2024 today).
